reproduced_findings: A rejected new-kind id getter was still read by duplicate ID collection and legacy resourceValid fallback; four genuine regression failures preserved.
A rejected kind getter or Proxy could execute during dispatch before the qualified validator, including downstream duplicate/batch/publication traversal; eight genuine regression failures preserved.
fix: Use a non-Proxy own data-property kind header before dispatch or downstream field reads. New-kind ID collection is guarded by its full qualified shape validator, and resourceValid returns that validator result immediately instead of falling through to legacy payload handling.
legacy_scope: Ordinary JSON targets of all four historical kinds keep their behavior and original regression expectations. A Proxy, inherited or accessor kind header is refused as invalid data; it is not a fifth legacy resource form or a permission. No old assertion is removed or weakened.
authority: No action, policy permission, selector kind, classifier branch, adapter dispatch or host/index effect is added. Continued classifier refusal and selector nonmatch remain mandatory.
